subject: MAP standup: private/VPC evaluation & deployment owner alignment
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Tanvi Patel <tanvi.patel@acmeco.com>, ops-lead@acmeco.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP standup: private/VPC evaluation & deployment owner alignment

Hi Tanvi / Acme team —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As discussed on the call, I wanted to get the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) moving so both sides have clarity on owners, timelines, and the eval scope for a private/VPC deployment of Redwood. Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook and a quick sketch of the proposed VPC topology.

Quick asks from our side to help us finalize the plan this week:
- Please confirm who will be the primary networking point-of-contact for VPN/peering (name + email).
- Please confirm the security/KMS owner for key management & who will be responsible for SOC2 evidence requests.
- Any blackout dates or procurement windows in Oct/Nov that would affect a production-go decision.

Proposed immediate milestones (dates are proposal only):
1) This week: agree MAP owners & finalize eval scope (agents, sample traffic, data residency).
2) Week of 10/11: network connectivity test (VPN / peering dry run).
3) Week of 10/18: private deployment smoke test + perf eval.
4) Target close decision by 11/05 (contract & committed capacity).

I’ve looped Karthik (AE) and Marissa (Solutions) who will run the MAP cadence from Redwood; Markus is our security engineer who can run a short KMS/KeyMgmt call.

Attachments: MAP-draft-2027-10-03.xlsx (MAP workbook, milestones), vpc-topology-sketch.drawio (sketch)

Thanks — open to adjusting dates if you have major conflicts.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Tanvi Patel <tanvi.patel@acmeco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-lead@acmeco.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP standup: private/VPC evaluation & deployment owner alignment

Irene — thanks for the clear plan and for sending the workbook. Quick replies inline: 

- Networking POC: Ravi Menon (ravi.menon@acmeco.com) — he’ll co-own the VPN/peering work and is copied on this thread (ops-lead@acmeco.com is his alias).
- Security/KMS: Tanvi (me) is the business owner; I’ll coordinate with our infra security lead (cc: ops-lead) on the technical KMS details.
- Procurement window: We have a vendor review week the week of 10/25, and the finance approval cycle typically takes two weeks from signed SOW. That makes your 11/05 target tight but still achievable if we parallelize connectivity and procurement tasks.

We’ll review the MAP workbook this afternoon and come back with comments. Can Markus pick one 30-min slot next week for a KMS scoping call?

— Tanvi
CTO Office, Acme Financial

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Tanvi Patel <tanvi.patel@acmeco.com>, ops-lead@acmeco.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP standup: private/VPC evaluation & deployment owner alignment

Thanks Tanvi — I can do a short KMS scope call. Proposed slots next week (PST):
- Tue 10/12 09:00–09:30
- Wed 10/13 11:00–11:30
- Thu 10/14 14:00–14:30

Agenda (15 min + buffer):
1) KMS key lifecycle & whether Acme will manage keys in KMS or provide HSM/KMS access to Redwood via IAM roles.
2) Audit log accessibility and retention expectations (SOC2 evidence scope).
3) Any FIPS/HSM requirements or BYOK needs.

If none of those work, happy to split into two short calls (infra + compliance).

— Markus
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP standup: private/VPC evaluation & deployment owner alignment

Great alignment team — thank you. Two quick coordination notes: 

1) Irene will own MAP cadence (weekly 30-min check-ins by default) — propose Fridays 10:00 PST starting 10/15. If that conflicts with your vendor review week, let us know and we’ll adjust.
2) Action items captured below (Irene: will add to the workbook and push a revised MAP v1.1 by tomorrow):
   - Acme: confirm final list of internal POCs (networking, infra security, procurement) — Tanvi / Ravi
   - Redwood: schedule KMS scoping call (Markus + Acme infra) — Markus to confirm slot
   - Redwood: prepare a short network checklist for the VPN/peering dry run (Irene + Marissa)
   - Procurement note: Karthik will share a sample commitment term sheet and draft SOW for legal review.

If everyone is good with the Friday cadence we’ll send recurring invite. Tanvi / Ravi, if you can share the best calendar contact for procurement and legal reviewers we’ll add them to the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth eval.

Regards,
